proposed_rules.trigger: A [2x1] bar at the very top of the page (y=0), full-width, listing nav categories, with no bg marker.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as the global primary nav (nav.json equivalent), exclude from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical position/content pattern across every captured page in this batch; not covered by knack-announcement-bar since it has no bg color.

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom zone (rc2) with a repeated tagline 'The best no-code platform for...' plus a small link row, appearing after main content on every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as the global footer fragment, exclude from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text/position across all sampled pages; site-wide chrome, not page content.

proposed_rules.trigger: A page under /integrations/... following the fixed sequence: hero -> how-it-works(bg) -> 3 steps(bg) -> popular-automations grid -> feature-highlight(bg) -> triggers-actions grid -> CTA -> about-vendor -> optional related-article.
proposed_rules.decision: Recognize as a dedicated 'integration' page template authored with 4 canonical reusable blocks (steps, automation-cards, feature-highlight, triggers-actions-list) rather than bespoke per-page blocks.
proposed_rules.rationale: Structure and order recur identically across every integration__* page sampled (C100-C105). Rejected alternatives: (a) treat each section as one-off bespoke blocks per page - rejected, causes massive duplication across dozens of integration pages; (b) collapse the whole page into one mega block - rejected, violates minimize-block-cells and blocks reuse.

proposed_rules.trigger: A single [3x1] card (not a repeated grid) teasing a blog/article near the page bottom.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as its own single-row 'related-article-card' block rather than folding into default-content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs with identical shape (H2 + one [3x1] card) at the tail of several integration pages; keeping it a block preserves the image+title+link structure. Rejected alternatives: fold into surrounding default-content as an inline link (loses structure); treat as an extra automation-cards row (different content type).
